fields.name: player_name
fields.description: Player's display name as the source reports it (an online player's is their Limitless display name, not a legal name)

fields.name: player_country
fields.description: Player's two-letter country code (e.g. "IT"), if reported

fields.name: placement
fields.description: Final placement for the team in the event

fields.name: record_wins
fields.description: Player's win count for the event, if reported

fields.name: record_losses
fields.description: Player's loss count for the event, if reported

fields.name: source_name
fields.description: "MunchStats" for official events, "Limitless Online" for online tournaments

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source URL or endpoint the record was resolved from

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Upstream MunchStats team identifier, or the online team id ("LP-<tournament>-<handle>")

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Dataset version this row was published under
